title: GTA 6 Reviews: Metacritic 99 and What Critics Loved (and Didn't)
desc: GTA 6 scored 99 on Metacritic, tying Ocarina of Time for the highest score ever. Here's the review roundup, the top scores and the few complaints.
lead: Grand Theft Auto VI didn't just review well. It landed on the very top of Metacritic's all-time list.
sections: The score

On PlayStation 5, GTA 6 holds a 99 Metascore from roughly 144–150 critic reviews. That ties The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest Metascore of all time. The Xbox Series X|S version also shows 99, from fewer reviews. On OpenCritic the Top Critic Average sits at 98–99, with nearly every critic recommending it.
Who gave it what

IGN and GameSpot both gave it a perfect 10/10, and Eurogamer and GamesRadar+ reportedly gave 5/5. The lowest major score reported is a 9/10, so there isn't a single negative review among the big outlets.
What critics loved
The size and detail of Leonida, the Jason and Lucia relationship at the heart of the story, and how alive Vice City feels came up again and again.
The complaints
Some reviewers noted that a few long-running Rockstar habits remain, like tightly scripted missions. Performance is capped at 30 FPS on every console (see our performance comparison).
Should you buy it?
If the scores matter to you, few games in history have scored higher. Check the price in your currency and our beginner guides before you start.

title: GTA 6 Sales: $3.79 Billion on Day One, the Biggest Launch Ever
desc: Take-Two estimates GTA 6 made about $3.79 billion on launch day with 32.5 million copies sold before release. Here's what the numbers mean.
lead: GTA 6 is now the biggest entertainment launch in history, bigger than any movie or album.
sections: The official number

Take-Two (Rockstar's parent company) estimates about $3.79 billion in global retail sales through the end of launch day, 19 November 2026, with 32.5 million copies sold before launch. These are the company's own estimates, not audited revenue.
The outside estimate
Analytics firm Sensor Tower put day one lower, at around 24.6 million digital copies and about $2.36 billion, including pre-orders. The two numbers measure different things, so both can be right.
How it compares
For comparison, GTA 5 made about $800 million in its first day back in 2013. GTA 6 roughly quadrupled that and beat every movie opening weekend ever recorded.
What it means for players
Huge sales mean Rockstar will keep supporting the game for years. The open questions are when GTA 6 Online and the PC version arrive.

title: GTA 6 Easter Eggs Found So Far: UFO, Skunk Ape, Jet-Ski Dog and More
desc: The best GTA 6 Easter eggs players have found so far: the UFO near Port Gellhorn, the Skunk Ape in Grassrivers, a dog with $1,218 and nods to older GTAs.
lead: Players have barely started exploring Leonida and the secrets are already piling up. Here are the most talked-about finds. None are officially confirmed by Rockstar, so treat locations as player reports.
sections: 🛸 UFO abduction
Reported near Port Gellhorn after 2 a.m. in-game. A classic GTA mystery is back.
🦍 The Skunk Ape
GTA 6's version of Bigfoot, reported in the swamps of Grassrivers.
🐕 The jet-ski dog
A dog on a jet ski leads you to a hidden island full of dogs and toys, where it digs up a wallet with $1,218.
🥚 A real egg nest
A nest of eggs sits on top of the Vice-Dale County radio tower: an Easter egg that is literally eggs.
📺 Pop-culture nods
An apartment on Washington Island looks a lot like the Bay Harbor building from Dexter, and Bug Stars, the pest-control company from GTA 5, is back.
🎮 Old GTA references
GTA 5's yoga teacher Fabien LaRouche shows up in a magazine, and there's a recreation of the classic Vice City cover pose.

title: Fastest Cars in GTA 6: Truffade Thrax, Progen Emerus and the Top Picks
desc: Which GTA 6 car is the fastest? The Truffade Thrax tops the in-game speed stat, with the Progen Emerus and Pegassi Vitello close behind.
lead: Everyone wants the fastest ride in Leonida. Guides agree on the top cars, but be careful: nobody has published proper tested top speeds yet.
sections: By the in-game Speed stat
Most guides put the Truffade Thrax first (about 8.7/10), then the Progen Emerus (8.3) and the Pegassi Vitello (8.2). One guide lists a modified Thrax at 9.2.
By estimated top speed
Estimates name the Grotti Itali RSX and the Thrax as the top contenders, but the mph numbers differ between sites, so treat them as estimates.
Get them free with cheats

Two of these are also cheat unlocks: the Truffade Thrax (finish all Shopping challenges) and the Progen Emerus (finish all Vehicle challenges). Codes for those aren't confirmed yet; see our cheat list for the 17 that are.
Tip
Damaged cars sell for less, so if you're selling stolen cars to Moses, drive carefully.

title: GTA 6 Radio Stations and Soundtrack: 800+ Songs Across 20+ Stations
desc: GTA 6 has the biggest soundtrack in series history: over 800 licensed tracks across 20+ radio stations, from '80s pop and rock to hip-hop, metal, Latin and Afrobeat.
lead: Half the fun of GTA is cruising with the radio on, and GTA 6 has more music than any GTA before it.
sections: How many stations and songs?
Guides count around 20–24 radio stations (some lists include talk stations) and over 800 licensed tracks. The exact numbers are still being finalized by fan lists.
What you'll hear

There's classic '70s/'80s soft rock and pop (think Elton John, Heart, Genesis), hip-hop on stations like VCRR and Dirty South Classics, metal on The Chamber 106.6, plus Latin, Afrobeat and modern pop and indie.
Deluxe soundtrack
A deluxe GTA VI soundtrack also features artists like Travis Scott, and new songs keep being released alongside the game.

title: GTA 6 on PS5 vs PS5 Pro vs Xbox Series X|S: Which Runs Best?
desc: GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on every console. PS5 Pro holds it best at about 1440p upscaled, PS5 and Series X tie, and Xbox Series S renders at 720p.
lead: Every version of GTA 6 targets 30 frames per second, but they don't all hold it equally well. Here's the short version of Digital Foundry's testing.
sections: 🥇 PS5 Pro: best
Holds around 30 FPS almost all the time (brief dips to about 24 FPS in big explosions), at about 1440p upscaled with PSSR. The sharpest and steadiest version.
🥈 PS5 and Xbox Series X: tied
Around 1440p, with frame rates between 30 and the high 20s in combat and fast driving, and occasional drops into the low 20s. Series X has a tiny smoothness edge thanks to 120Hz VRR.
🥉 Xbox Series S: weakest
Renders at 720p upscaled to about 1080p, with drops to around 20 FPS in heavy scenes and lower-quality lighting, shadows and textures. Still playable, but clearly behind.
Any 60 FPS mode?
No. There's no performance mode on any console at launch, and the first patch didn't change that (see our patch notes). PC is still unannounced (PC status).

title: GTA 6 Online Release Date: Is Multiplayer Coming? (What's Confirmed)
desc: Rockstar hasn't announced GTA 6 Online or a release date. The 2027 rumor comes from Twitch's CEO, not Rockstar. Here's everything that's actually confirmed.
lead: GTA 6 launched as a single-player game. So when can you play online with friends? Short answer: nobody officially knows yet.
sections: What Rockstar has said
Nothing about a date. Rockstar hasn't announced a GTA 6 Online mode at all, and its 19 November launch post covered the story, soundtrack and launch bonuses without mentioning multiplayer.
Where '2027' comes from
Twitch CEO Dan Clancy told Bloomberg he expects GTA multiplayer next year. That's his expectation, not a Rockstar announcement.
What about GTA Online (GTA 5)?
Take-Two says it will keep supporting the existing GTA Online after GTA 6's release, so it isn't shutting down.
Beware scams
Any site offering "GTA 6 Online early access" or a "beta invite" is a scam. Read our scam alerts.

title: GTA 6 Update 1.002.002: Patch Notes, Crash Fixes and What's Still Broken
desc: GTA 6's first patch (01.002.002 on PS5, 1.0.2.2 on Xbox) fixes crashes, stuck weather, autosaves, story phone calls and a Wanted Level bug. Here's the full list.
lead: Four days after launch, Rockstar pushed GTA 6's first update. It's small, but it fixes some of the most annoying launch bugs.
sections: Version and size
01.002.002 on PS5 (about 604 MB) and 1.0.2.2 on Xbox Series X|S (about 1.6 GB), released 23 November 2026.
What's fixed

Several crashes (Rockstar didn't say which), story phone calls that didn't trigger and could block progress, autosave problems, weather getting stuck for long periods, and a Wanted Level you couldn't lose. Some outlets also list a gym deadlift fix and a partner loot-bag fix.
Not fixed yet

Rockstar's notes don't mention the Xbox bug that makes the game run at double speed, and there's no performance change (still 30 FPS). Rockstar also hasn't said whether progress lost before the patch can be recovered.
Crashing on PS5?
If you see error CE-108255-1, install the update, keep your console's system software updated, and rebuild the database from Safe Mode if it continues. Always save manually before big missions.

title: How Big Is the GTA 6 Map? Leonida vs GTA 5 Explained
desc: Rockstar says Leonida is about twice the size of GTA 5's map and close to GTA 4, GTA 5 and Red Dead 2 combined. Here's what the square-mile estimates really mean.
lead: Leonida is the biggest map Rockstar has ever built. But you'll see wildly different square-mile numbers online, so here's what's actually known.
sections: What Rockstar said

Rockstar's only official comparison is a ratio: Leonida is roughly twice the size of GTA 5's map, about three times Red Dead Redemption 2's, and nearly as large as the maps of GTA 4, GTA 5 and RDR2 combined.
Why the square miles differ

There's no official square-mile figure. Estimates range from about 32 to 59 square miles depending on what size people assume GTA 5 was, and on whether water is counted. One outlier claims 120+, but it starts from a much bigger GTA 5 figure.
The 6 regions
Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga. See them all on our characters & map page.

title: GTA 6 PC Release Date: Latest News (November 2026)
desc: GTA 6 is out on PS5 and Xbox, but there's still no official PC release date. Here's the latest report, Rockstar's history and how to avoid fake PC downloads.
lead: The number one question from PC players: when? Here's everything we know, updated for November 2026.
sections: Official status
No PC version has been announced. GTA 6 launched on 19 November 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only, and Take-Two's investor schedule lists only those consoles through 31 March 2027.
The rumor
On 13 October 2026, GamesBeat reported (citing unnamed sources) that a PC version could arrive in the first three months of 2027. Rockstar didn't comment, so it isn't confirmed.
Rockstar's history
GTA 4 reached PC 7 months after console, GTA 5 took 19 months, and Red Dead Redemption 2 took about a year. Full details are on our PC status page.
⚠️ Fake downloads
Any "GTA 6 PC download" or "crack" right now is a scam or malware. Never enter passwords or card details on those sites.

title: How to Unlock GTA 6 Cheats Fast: Every Unlock Goal Explained
desc: GTA 6 cheats must be unlocked first. Here are the goals: 100 workouts for Body Armor, 50 stunt jumps for Unlimited Nitrous, shooting-range medals for ammo and more.
lead: Unlike older GTAs, GTA 6 cheats are locked until you complete a goal. Typing a code before that does nothing. Here's how to unlock the useful ones fastest.
sections: Finish the story first
Four cheats unlock when the main story ends: $250,000, Unlimited Focus, Attack Force and Cycle Weather.
Fitness and stunts
Body Armor: do 100 workouts. Unlimited Nitrous: complete 50 stunt jumps. Parachute: 50 skydives or BASE jumps from 300 ft or higher. No Fall Damage: survive a 40-ft fall 20 times.
Shooting range medals

Collectibles
10 watches unlock Move Time Forward and 20 unlock Pause Time of Day. Finding all 24 Vice City Flamingos cards unlocks the Bubblegum filter.

title: GTA 6 Criminal Profile Explained: Professional to Irredeemable
desc: How GTA 6's Criminal Profile works: the five states, what pushes you toward Psycho, how to stay Professional, the cracked icon warning and the permanent Irredeemable lock.
lead: GTA 6 quietly watches how Jason and Lucia commit crimes, not just whether they do. The Criminal Profile grades your style, gives Focus bonuses to match it, and can lock you into a permanent state if you go too far. Here's how it works.
sections: The five states

Guides based on the released game list five states: Professional (clean, quiet, non-lethal), Hardened (uses force when spotted), Violent (attacks cops and civilians), Psycho (extreme, pointless violence) and Irredeemable (a permanent lock). Some sites call the second state "Aggressive", so you may see both names.
What pushes you toward Psycho

Killing cops, hurting civilians (especially ones running away or defenceless), killing pets or vulnerable animals and causing unnecessary destruction all move the profile up. Threats, like holding up a store clerk, and self-defence don't count against you, and a clean robbery isn't punished by itself.
How to stay Professional

Avoid violence unless you're threatened, stay undetected, use non-lethal takedowns and only do what the job needs. The good news: Hardened, Violent and even Psycho can be walked back by playing cleaner for a while.
The cracked icon: your last warning
If your Psycho icon starts to crack, stop. It's the warning before Irredeemable. Sources disagree on how many warning stages there are, so treat any crack as the final one.
Irredeemable is permanent

Once the profile hits Irredeemable it doesn't come back in normal play, and it affects both characters. One guide says the only fix is loading a save from before it happened, so keep a manual save before you go on a rampage.
What it changes

Each style earns Focus differently: quiet players get it for non-lethal takedowns, violent players for headshots. Psycho players reportedly can't surrender to police. GTABase says the profile plays a part in which ending you get, but exact story effects aren't fully confirmed yet. Jason and Lucia have separate profiles, but their actions affect each other when they're together.

title: GTA 6 Hidden Controls: Tricks the Game Never Explains
desc: GTA 6 hidden controls for PS5 and Xbox: flip a car back over, sit anywhere, the vehicle menu, WAiNK car scanning, push boats into the water, slide over hoods and more.
lead: GTA 6 has a huge control scheme and the tutorial skips a lot of it. These are the most useful hidden controls, with PS5 and Xbox buttons (default layout).
sections: Flip a car back on its wheels

Car upside down? Walk up to its side and hold Square / X to push it over. It can fail if the car is too heavy, you run out of stamina or you're on a steep slope. The same move shoves a boat or jet ski off the sand into the water.
Sit or rest anywhere
Hold Circle / B on foot to sit on grass or sand, lean against a wall or rest. A quick tap of the same button crouches instead.
The vehicle controls menu
Hold D-pad Left in a car to open the vehicle menu: engine off/on, hazard lights, trunk and windows. It's new to the series.
Scan cars with WAiNK
Hold D-pad Up to open the WAiNK app, then hold R1 / RB to scan a vehicle and see its class, whether it's locked and whether it's tracked. Handy before you steal something hot.
Duck from the cops
In a car, hold Circle / B to duck down and stay out of sight.
Slide over the hood
Run at a car and press X / A to slide over the hood. Press X / A right after climbing to chain jumps.
Throw things
R2 / RT throws the object you're holding, yes, including at people.
Talk back to Leonida
R1 / RB flips someone off, clicking the right stick yells at pedestrians and drivers, and holding L2 / LT whistles to get attention. Bike riders can bunnyhop with Circle / B.
Classic layout
Miss the old GTA controls? There are three control schemes in the settings. Classic swaps Run and Crouch back to how older games played.
